result.statement: MOC4 holds for every complex normal 4-by-4 pair whenever either matrix has a repeated eigenvalue. Separately, any pair with a common nontrivial reducing subspace reduces to the known n<=3 cases and therefore satisfies MOC4.
result.mechanism: For A=diag(alpha,alpha,gamma,delta), the Cauchy-Binet determinant expansion needs only the one-point unistochastic marginals P and one designated 2-row-set compound-minor law q. A fractional-orientation/max-flow construction lifts P and q to one probability law on S4. Equal coefficients for row pairs 13/23 and 14/24 then make the remaining k=2 compound terms match by inclusion identities; k=1 and k=3 match by one-point/complementary minors.
result.peer_interface: Consumes account03/B09 MOC4-C2-COMPLEMENT-BOUND-v1: its general middle-layer orientation/parity obstruction disappears under the repeated-eigenvalue row-swap symmetry, and the surviving complementary-pair law is coupled exactly to P by an actual S4 lift.
result.singular_boundary: included directly; no inversion or limiting argument is used

cross_account_consumption.use: Applied the peer's complementary-pair/orientation separation to identify exactly what spectral equality removes; supplied an exact common-permutation lift on that boundary.

remaining_obligation: Unrestricted simple-spectrum irreducible MOC4 remains open. Next attack: control the orientation/parity term away from the repeated-eigenvalue face, or prove that L1+L3 slack absorbs it under a common S4 support functional.
